reading.title: A Walk to the Pond
reading.purpose: Follow Kai and Mom on a walk to a pond.
paras: Kai and Mom walked a wide trail. Soon the hill grew steep. A thin stream ran beside the path, and it was shallow.
At the top, a pond was deep and blue. Kai wore thick socks. Mom's pencil was dull, so she found a sharp one and drew the pond.

qs.q: The hill grew steep. What does steep mean?
qs.why: A steep hill rises at a sharp slant, so it is hard to climb.

qs.q: Why did Mom find a sharp pencil?
qs.why: The reading says Mom's pencil was dull, so she found a sharp one.
The reading says the pond at the top was deep and blue.

reading.retellFrame: On the walk, the path was ___ and the hill was ___.
